name: Message codes plus
description: Word wrap, bigger/smaller text, bold and italic, keywords coloured automatically, text macros and the name box position for Show Text.

settings_schema.label: Word wrap every message
settings_schema.help:
Line breaks typed in a message become spaces and the text flows to the box edge;
starts a new line. or in a message overrides this for that message.

settings_schema.label: Keywords coloured automatically
settings_schema.help: Whole words written in this colour wherever a message uses them (upper or lower case).

settings_schema.label: Text macros
settings_schema.help: \M[name] in a message is replaced by the text (which may use codes itself).

settings_schema.label: Draw a window behind the name
